description.value: The Log Cabin & Bunkhouse is a seasonal retreat on the DeeKayTee Ranch, a family-run working farm in the Comox Valley north of Courtenay on Vancouver Island, operating since 1926. The bunkhouse sits in a forested setting with panoramic mountain views and offers a quiet, private escape on an active beef, poultry, and produce farm. Guests can browse the on-farm market for locally raised meats, eggs, jams, and baked goods.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is operational, corroborates the OSM phone number and address (adding Courtenay, BC V9J 1M9), and describes a seasonal bunkhouse on a working farm. However, the site contains no mention of bike storage, cycling facilities, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific services, so all bike-related criteria default to null. The farm market and farm description pages confirm the rural, agricultural character of the property.
concerns: Seasonal operation only (April 1 – September 30); closed in winter months.
No cyclist-specific facilities or services mentioned anywhere on the website.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; website provides the full address as Courtenay, BC V9J 1M9 — used here as the enriched value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property is a legitimate seasonal guesthouse in a cycling-relevant area of Vancouver Island, but the website makes no mention of any cyclist-specific amenities — including the two required criteria (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure). Direct outreach is needed to determine whether the property can meet WWC minimum requirements before listing.

wow_evidence: family-run working farm in the Comox Valley... operating since 1926
